messages:
mira: heads up — after the RBAC role rename this morning we're seeing SCIM create duplicates for ~12 users in prod. looks like externalId normalization mismatch between idp and our SCIM handler :/
aj: ugh. any logs or examples? is it externalId vs email?
mira: example: Okta user with externalId `company\\\\user123` (backslash) came in as `company/user123` to SCIM. SCIM returned 201 then later 409 on PATCHs. seeing KMS decrypt warnings around the same time. full minimal log: 
```
ERROR scim-handler: create_user failed status=201 id=usr_abc123
WARN kms: decrypt failed context_mismatch: kms-context=env:prod key_alias=alias/redwood-scim (attempt 1)
INFO scim-handler: update_user failed status=409 remote_id=00u1abcd duplicateExternalId
```
leo: interesting — role rename might have triggered a mapping change that strips or replaces path separators. are we normalizing externalId anywhere?
sarah: we changed the RBAC mapping in the mapping-service config at 09:12, that PR replaced `role.path` -> `role_path`. could be a string transform side-effect.
aj: can you reproduce locally with same payload? can you paste the raw SCIM POST body (sanitized) that created the duplicate?
mira: pasted sanitized body: 
```
POST /scim/v2/Users
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "mira@example.com",
  "externalId": "company\\user123",  # from idp
  "name": {"givenName":"Mira","familyName":"K"}
}
```
leo: then our SCIM lookup sees `company/user123` (we convert backslashes to slashes somewhere). search in mapping-service for `.replace('\\\\','/')` ?
aj: also KMS decrypt warning could mean the SCIM service tried to decrypt an encrypted attribute (we store encrypted provisioning tokens). if KMS context differs because the request came from a different AZ, decrypt fails and we retry, causing a race with create -> update. sec-bot: alert 1759991201: scim-create-duplicate-count > 10 in 5m.
oncall: oncall pinged — assigning to aj.
aj: I'm looking at mapping-service logs — there is indeed a normalization step added in the RBAC PR that runs a `sanitize_path` helper which does `s.replace('\\\\','/')` unexpectedly on all role-ish fields. That function is used by the provisioning pipeline.
sarah: oh no. we scoped it to roles but forgot it's shared via lib to scim mapper. rollback possible?
aj: quick mitigation: patch sanitize_path to only run for role paths and not externalId, then restart mapping-service. patch diff: 
```
- def sanitize_path(s):
-   return s.replace('\\\\','/')
+ def sanitize_role_path(p):
+   if p is None: return p
+   return p.replace('\\\\','/')
```
mira: will that stop new duplicates? yes/no?
leo: it should stop future ones but we need to dedupe existing duplicates and repair SCIM/Okta state. plan: 1) stop mapping-service patch deploy 2) run dedupe job that finds externalId variants and merges 3) re-run provisioning to sync roles.
aj: writing a one-off SQL to detect probable duplicates: 
```
SELECT external_id, array_agg(id) as ids, count(*) FROM users
WHERE external_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY external_id
HAVING count(*) > 1;
-- also check normalized variants
SELECT id, external_id, replace(external_id, '\\\\', '/') as norm FROM users
WHERE replace(external_id, '\\\\', '/') != external_id;
```
sarah: KMS bit — we saw `context_mismatch` because mapping-service calls KMS with an encryption context that included `instance-id` which is different on the new instance pool. We should stop using instance-id in context for scim tokens; context must be stable across instances.
leo: agree. change KMS usage to a stable context: `service=scim,env=prod` and rotate keys if necessary.
mira: ETA to patch mapping-service and KMS context?
aj: patch PR ready, rolling to canary in prod now. no full restart required; it's a config roll and a tiny code change.
sarah: for dedupe I'll prepare a script to merge duplicates via SCIM: try to PATCH target with canonical externalId and then DELETE orphan. script sample: 
```
# for each dup set
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{masterId}
{"externalId":"company/user123"}
DELETE /scim/v2/Users/{orphanId}
```
sec-bot: note: opening incident INC-2024-456 if merges will touch >50 users.
aj: small note — before deleting, we should export audit logs (SCIM and Okta) and KMS decrypt attempts. I'll run export now.
mira: thanks. will monitor for new duplicates and post results in #incidents if anything spikes. :eyes: 
leo: postmortem action items: add unit test to mapping lib to ensure externalId not mutated, move sanitize function to role-only code, remove instance-id from KMS encryption context, add SCIM de-duplication check to provisioning job.
sarah: acknowledged, will create tickets and link to this thread.
aj: rollback not needed, canary looks clean. duplicates stopped after canary cutover.
mira: closing loop — fixed and cleanup job in progress, will update when dedupe script finishes. :thumbsup:
